Raw hex address 0x55f37c assigned to bare local `iVar6`. The decompiler dropped a symbolic reference — either a data-symbol pointer (recover the symbol from the .asm and replace `iVar6` with symbolic global/array indexing, §11) or a dead code-address store from return-address tracking (delete it, §14). Magic addresses do not survive the relink.
Watcom loop-unrolled strcpy (2-byte-at-a-time do-while with mid-body null check). Replace the whole loop with strcpy() in a .keep.
Watcom field-by-field struct copy (3 consecutive `dst.field = src.field;` lines). Replace with `dst = src;` or `memcpy(&dst, &src, sizeof(...));` in a .keep.
Watcom cascade constant fill (3 sibling fields chained through prior store of `0.0`). Replace with 3 direct stores of the constant in a .keep.
